reasoning: Xi Jinping has consolidated control over the CCP, removed term limits, and faces no visible internal threat. His removal via coup, resignation, or incapacity within the next ~1.5 years is extremely improbable, far below the 7% implied by the market. A 1% true probability assumes a tail-risk scenario of sudden health failure or extreme political upheaval, both with no current evidence.
evidence_points: Xi eliminated presidential term limits in 2018, signaling indefinite leadership intentions.
The 20th Party Congress (Oct 2022) re-elected him General Secretary with no opposition, cementing his third term.
No credible reporting suggests factional challenges, coup plotting, or serious health issues that would force removal before end-2026.
sources_consulted: Credible media reports on Xi’s health and party dynamics (2023-2025)
